entities.summary: Jordan Martinook is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger and alternate captain for the Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Phoenix Coyotes in the second round of the 2012 NHL entry draft.
